title: In This Town, If You Lie, Your House Drives Away
hook: In this town, liars lose their house
description: I never lied. Not once. Until my little sister asked me one question…

scenes.narration: In this town, if you tell a lie, your house drives away.
That's why everybody here is painfully honest.
My neighbor told me he loved my cooking. His house was gone before lunch.
The mayor promised lower taxes. The whole town hall rolled straight into the sea.
Me? I have never lied. Not once. My house hasn't moved in twelve years.
Until the night my little sister asked me if monsters are real.
I didn't want to scare her. So I said no.
The engine started before I even finished the sentence.
My house drove off into the storm. With me still inside.
It didn't stop until the mountains. And something there was waiting.
A giant. Fifty meters tall, with eyes like headlights.
It leaned down, right in front of me, and whispered: you told her I wasn't real.
Behind it stood hundreds of houses. Every house that ever drove away from a lie.
So I did the only thing that works in this town. I told the truth. Monsters are real.
And my house drove me home by sunrise.
Now my sister has a fifty meter tall best friend. And nobody in this town lies about monsters anymore.
